components.gap: Success-condition element 'preserve the identified source variants' is not met. Huber 1964 Sec. 4 Example (iii) (printed p.79, inside the cited Secs. 1-7) states that, with t_0 = T_n(x), observations with |x_i - t_0| > k may be replaced by t_0 +- k 'without changing the estimate T_n(x)', and that t_0 is then the arithmetic mean of the modified sample. The entry (body lines 145-147) keeps only the second conjunct plus 'the score still vanishes at t_0'; the annex (lines 191-194) proves only that t_0 still minimizes the modified criterion and adds that the replacement 'need not preserve every tie-breaking rule for every modified sample'. Neither the body nor the annex states or proves that the defined estimate T_{n,k} of the modified sample equals T_{n,k}(x) (which requires showing t_0 is the unique zero of the modified score), and no other file on the reader route supplies it. The source's estimate-invariance claim is therefore neither preserved nor explicitly corrected, and the annex hedge leaves its status undetermined.

defect_observations.observation: The Winsorizing replacement is stated for any zero t_0 and the annex says it 'need not preserve every tie-breaking rule'. For t_0 equal to the defined estimate the source's stronger claim holds (after replacement t_0 is the unique zero of the modified score, because an active observation or the two saturated groups give strictly negative one-sided slopes at t_0), but it is neither stated nor proved. This is the gap recorded for C007.

Huber 1964 p.77 Remark after Lemma 3 (consistency under 'lambda finite somewhere and not identically zero on any nondegenerate interval') is not carried anywhere on the route (grep found no occurrence). Not counted as a failure: the entry reproduces Lemmas 2-3 exactly and the remark is an equivalent reformulation given Lemma 2.

The consistency-failure example rho(t)=(t^2-1)^2, X=0 has psi'(t)=12t^2-4, which is not uniformly continuous, and E psi'(X) = -4 < 0, so it violates two other premises of the same theorem. It shows inconsistency of a smooth nonconvex minimizer but does not isolate the consistency premise within the theorem's hypotheses (an in-regime example such as rho(t)=1-cos t, X=0, T_n=2 pi would). Recorded as an observation; the stated example and its claims are proved (annex 167-170).

The chapter's locators are Secs. 2-4 and 7 (line 9) and Sec. 8 (line 419) of Huber 1965, but the section 'The source's extensions and their exact premises' (lines 349-415, components C012-C014) draws on Secs. 5-6 (printed pp.1756-1757). The attributions are supported by the held source; only the locator omits Secs. 5-6.

Monotonicity on S of the extended endpoint ratio with values 0 and infinity (the varying-support case the body promises) is asserted ('The same pointwise cross-product condition implies...') without the short case check (e.g. r(x)=infinity and x<y in S force p_theta0(y)=0). Not counted as a failure.

Huber 1964 p.75 pairs the limiting cases with epsilon (mean: k=infinity, epsilon=0; median: k=0, epsilon=1). The entry treats epsilon=0 and k decreasing to 0 but does not state the epsilon-to-k correspondence; it follows from C'(k)<0 with limits infinity and one proved in annex 251-254. Minor.

Source Example (iii) (p.79) displays the variance with denominator (integral over [-k,k] of F(dt))^2 for general F; the entry gives the corrected half-weight A_F(k) for symmetric F and notes the half weight is necessary, without saying that this corrects the source display. Not counted as a failure.
